newsitem.title: USA: Prentiss Properties plans 10mln shr offering.
newsitem.headline: Prentiss Properties plans 10mln shr offering.

text.p: Prentiss Properties Trust, a national office and industrial real estate investment trust said Wednesday it will offer 10 million shares of common stock to the public, under a registration statement filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission on March 26.

The net proceeds to Prentiss Properties Trust are expected to be about $260 million, which will be used to acquire 15 office buildings totaling 1.6 million square feet, and 14 industrial buildings totaling 1.9 million square feet, that the company has identified and is in the process of closing.
The pending acquisitions are located in California, Illinois, Georgia, Maryland, Michigan and Texas.

Prentiss Properties Trust is a self-administered and self-managed real estate investment trust that owns interests in 102 office and industrial properties with about 10.9 million net rentable square feet.
